Stock market news | Sensex jumps 1,400 points amid inflows, crude fall

On 25 November 2026 the Sensex jumped more than 1,400 points, pushing the index up over 1.5% after a sell-off on Monday. The rise was driven by fresh foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices and a stronger rupee, boosting investor confidence and adding roughly ₹2.2 lakh crore to market wealth.
